A triangular plate of mass $M$ occupies the region $D$ in the first quadrant enclosed by the lines $y=x,$ $x=2,$ and the $x$-axis. The mass density at each point is proportional to the square of its distance from the $y$-axis. Find the moment of inertia of the plate about the $y$-axis.
